The glow has a soft white-to-warm gradient, touching the edge of the artwork's gold frame and casting a gentle halo against the greige wall. Camera is at standing eye-level, slightly left of center, with the art frame and sofa top in the right third of the frame and the illuminated wall occupying the central and left thirds.
